about: How far the cold start on two machines may differ from the one-machine App journeys on the same pull request and still count as clean (docs/research/faster-checks.md, proposal 4; Round 6, R4, M7.6). Recompute with .github/scripts/cold_start_allowances.py; never edit a value by hand.

method.runs: App journeys jobs (pull requests and main) whose journeys step ran and logged seven cold starts; each run's median is the 4th of its 7, as startup.sh takes it
method.noisePairs: every pair of runs of the same app: the same inputs as app-journeys.yml's built-app key (the tracked files of product/app, product/packages, pnpm-lock.yaml and .node-version, without product/app/journeys/, product/app/scripts/, product/app/bundle-limit.json and product/app/vitest.config.ts); a pull request's job builds the merge of its head into its base (its log's "Merge <head> into <base>" line), so a pull request run's key is the inputs at its head and at its base, and a main run's the inputs at its own commit twice; a pull request run with no such line is left out
method.allowance: max(floor, margin x the largest |difference of the two runs' medians| over the noise pairs)
method.fiveComparisonAverage: over the five pull requests counted for the switch, the average of (two-machine median - one-machine median) must stay within this: the 99.9th percentile of the same average over 20,000 random sets of five noise pairs, one pair from each of five different groups, with random signs

proof.leaveBothRunsOut: 84 of 85 noise pairs clean (98.8%), each judged with the allowance from pairs sharing neither run; five in a row 94%; two of the first five not clean by noise alone 0.1%
proof.marginsCompared: 1.1, 1.25, 1.5 and 2.0 were all clean on 85 of 85 but blunter (a +1,000 ms shift flagged 74%, 60%, 33% and 1% of the time); 1.0 is the tightest that passes nearly always
proof.oldRule: the median inside the other run's lowest-to-highest of seven: 58 of 85 (68%); five in a row 15%
proof.failures: of all 148 jobs whose journeys ran, 4 failed: 2 a change in progress (the sign-in test screen being built), 1 the cold-start step itself (9 November: couldn't read the start or the first content from Android's log), 1 with no log; in the 108 runs that reached the cold start it failed once, and no flow failed by itself
proof.coldStartVerdicts: all 107 passed against main; no data on how often noise flips one
proof.noiseSpread: |difference of two same-app medians|: median 180 ms, 90th percentile 421 ms, largest 761 ms; medians across all runs from 773 to 1842 ms
proof.duplicates: none: no two runs share a start time or the same seven cold starts
